units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 34b:1">B. Bath. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>דהוו מינצו עלה בי ת׳</he> about which two persons had a dispute.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 5:4:3">Y. Dem. V, 24ᵈ</cite> top <he>וחד מן דת׳</he> and one buys bread of two bakers.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 5:4:3">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>ת׳ כל קביל ת׳</he> two authorities against two.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 65a:17">Kidd. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳</he> are both done to him (forcing and persuading)?; a. fr.—With suff. <cite ref="V00960"><he>תַּרְוֵי־</he></cite>, <he>תְּרֵי־</he>; <he>תַּרְתֵּי־</he>.

<cite ref="Leviticus 5">B’ḥuck. 5</cite> <he>מבין תַּרְוֵיהוֹן וכ׳</he> between the two that luckless woman died; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:15:1">Koh. R. to X, 15</cite> <he>מביני תרייה וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="O00385"><he>סוּף</he></cite> II ch.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:4:13">Y. Meg. I, 70ᵈ</cite> top [read:] <he>ר׳ … ור׳ יהושע בן לוי תְּרֵיהוֹן אמרין</he> R. Ḥ. and R. J. ben L. both say.
<cite ref="Chullin 45a:14">Ḥull. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>דאמרי תַרְוַיְיהוּ</he> both of them say.

B. Kam. 60ᵇ אימא … דשויא לתַרְוַיְיכוּ I will tell you something that fits both of you; Snh. 39ᵃ לתרוייכו Ms. M. (ed. לתרוייהו appropriate to both questions); a. fr.—תְּרֵין עֲשַׂר, תְּרֵי עֲ׳; f. תַּרְתָּא עַשְׂרֵי; contr. תְּרֵיסַר, תְּרִיסְרֵי; f. תַּרְתֵּי סְרֵי, תַּרְתֵּיסְרֵי twelve.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 16b">B. Mets. 16ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ת׳ ירחי שתא</he>, v. <cite ref="J00624"><he>יַרְחָא</he></cite>; a. fr.
